name: 女式宽松抓绒连帽卫衣款

category.leaf: 女式宽松抓绒连帽卫衣

description: 落肩宽松廓形、绒面内里、大容量插袋，秋冬通勤与居家两穿

styleLock.backgroundSystem: matte seamless paper cyclorama in warm studio white #FAF7F2 and oatmeal greige #E7E0D6 for on-body screens, one cream fleece-pile field #F5EDE2 for texture and lifestyle screens, one camel matte board #B98A5E reserved for the closing screen; flat fields only, no gradient, no environmental props beyond the two lifestyle anchors
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright warm high-key studio light from a large frontal softbox with a left fill card, low skimming side light only where fabric relief must read, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars and no coloured gels
styleLock.surfaceSystem: matte seamless paper floor and wall in the same tone, cream brushed-pile textile surface for texture screens, camel matte board for the closing flat layout
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif with wide letter spacing, single family only, one headline plus short labels, all rendered copy left as empty reserved space
styleLock.iconSystem: single-weight thin line icons and dotted leader lines in deep charcoal #1C1C20, unlettered rounded callout pills and empty stamp frames, no filled glyphs, no badges
styleLock.presentationRules: on-body garment kept at a stable straight-on or slight 3/4 angle with identical drape, hem and hood always fully in frame, no mannequin, no floating garment, garment never re-proportioned between screens
noDrift: no colour palette changes away from #FAF7F2, #E7E0D6, #F5EDE2 and #B98A5E
no mixed fonts or handwritten type
no random backgrounds or gradient backdrops
no inconsistent lighting or coloured gels between screens
no filled icons, badges, stars or certification seals
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium warm-neutral women's loungewear ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of warm studio white #FAF7F2, oatmeal greige #E7E0D6, cream fleece pile #F5EDE2 and one camel accent #B98A5E, with deep charcoal #1C1C20 reserved for hairlines only; bright warm high-key studio lighting from a large frontal softbox with a left fill card, low skimming side light only where fabric relief must read, soft contact shadows and no harsh speculars; modern geometric sans-serif with wide letter spacing; single-weight thin-line icon style with dotted leader lines and unlettered rounded callout pills; matte seamless paper cyclorama and brushed textile pile surfaces, no gradient; clean high-end apparel photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable straight-on or slight 3/4 on-body garment angle with identical drape and scale; no colour palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 在搜索列表里一眼拿下点击，交代宽松落肩廓形与整身比例。
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level full-figure view, garment seen from hood to hem
shots.lighting: bright warm high-key studio light, large frontal softbox with left fill card, soft contact shadow at the hem
shots.whitespace: none, the figure fills the frame
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce on-body packshot of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The garment photographed straight-on at eye level in a full-figure framing, hood to hem fully visible and nothing cropped by the edge. Bright warm high-key studio light from a large frontal softbox with a left fill card, only a soft contact shadow where the hem meets the floor. Matte seamless backdrop #FAF7F2. No props. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame with no extra whitespace. 8K commercial apparel quality. Negative: no face or identifiable features, no phone or mirror in frame, no second garment as co-subject, no hangtag or wordmark lettering, no watermark, no cut-off sleeve or hem, no floating garment without a contact shadow.

shots.intent: 一秒给出核心利益：落肩垂坠感与大容量插袋，主图一秒法则。
shots.camera: slight 3/4 angle, half-figure framed from the hip to the crown of the hood
shots.lighting: soft front-left key with a low skimming side light from camera right lifting the drape
shots.props: one unlettered rounded callout pill floating clear of the silhouette
shots.whitespace: generous negative space on the right 40% for copy
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The garment shown at a slight 3/4 angle in a half-figure framing from the hip to the crown of the hood, hands resting at the pocket opening. Soft front-left key light with a low skimming side light from camera right that reads the drape and the pocket edge. Seamless backdrop #E7E0D6. One empty rounded callout pill shape sits clear of the silhouette. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame, leaving generous negative space on the right 40% for copy. Negative: no lettering rendered inside the callout pill, no more than one claim, no invented fabric weight or warmth rating, no face, no harsh specular sheen on the fabric, no palette drift.

shots.intent: 用买家自拍视角完成代入，证明松弛上身效果适合日常外出。
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level mirror framing, figure cropped just below the chin
shots.lighting: soft interior daylight balance at 5600K from camera left, gentle falloff, faint floor contact shadow
shots.background: cream wall #F5EDE2 with a slim unframed mirror edge
shots.props: a plain hand-held phone and one small flap shoulder bag on a fine chain strap
shots.whitespace: none, the reflection fills the frame
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene: {product} worn and captured as a mirror reflection. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on eye-level mirror framing with the figure cropped just below the chin so no facial identity appears. Soft interior daylight at 5600K from camera left, gentle falloff and a faint contact shadow on the floor. Cream wall #F5EDE2 with a slim unframed mirror edge. Props: a plain phone held at chest height and one small flap shoulder bag on a fine chain strap carrying no hardware marks. The product occupies 40-50% of the frame with no extra whitespace. Negative: no recognisable face, no phone brand mark, no hand blocking the pocket opening, no duplicated or warped reflection figure, no chain charms or clutter, no watermark.

shots.intent: 低机位场景镜证明蹲坐不紧绷、日常耐穿，强化生活方式代入。
shots.camera: low angle from a crouching vantage, camera close to the floor looking slightly upward
shots.lighting: warm open-shade light at 5800K from camera left, long soft shadow on the floor
shots.background: matte seamless warm studio white #FAF7F2 meeting a floor in the same tone
shots.props: one plain unprinted paper takeaway cup with a blank lid and unbranded chunky sneakers
shots.whitespace: none, the crouching figure fills the frame
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene: {product} worn by a figure crouching in an easy run-about moment. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a low angle at a crouching vantage, camera close to the floor and looking slightly upward, the whole garment visible. Warm open-shade light at 5800K from camera left casting one long soft shadow. Seamless backdrop #FAF7F2 meeting a floor of the same tone. Props: one plain unprinted paper takeaway cup with a blank lid, plus unbranded chunky sneakers. The product occupies 40-50% of the frame with no extra whitespace. Negative: no face, no readable cup print or logo, no spilled liquid, no fused or extra fingers, no distorted knee, no watermark.

shots.intent: 用背侧结构镜解释帽型与后过肩做工，消除版型与厚度疑虑。
shots.camera: from behind at a 45-degree rear angle, upper back and hood filling the frame
shots.lighting: soft rim light skimming the hood curve from camera upper-left, low open fill on the shadow side
shots.whitespace: generous negative space above the shoulder line
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce structure detail of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from behind at a 45-degree rear angle so the hood, back yoke and sleeve setting all read clearly, framed tight on the upper back. Soft rim light skimming the hood curve from camera upper-left with a low open fill keeping the shadow side legible. Seamless backdrop #E7E0D6. No props. The garment occupies 55-60% of the frame with generous negative space above the shoulder line. Negative: no face turned toward camera, no invented panels or extra seams, no size tab or label lettering, no tangled drawcords, no watermark.

shots.intent: 微距特写证明面料质感与织造做工，是视觉驱动品的信任支点。
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro, lens skimming just above the fabric surface, shallow depth of field
shots.lighting: low skimming side light from camera right modelling the pile, no specular blowout
shots.background: cream fleece pile field #F5EDE2 falling out of focus behind the focal point
shots.whitespace: minimal, the texture is the subject
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of the fabric surface of {product}, tight zoom on the knit face and its brushed relief. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The lens skims just above the surface in an extreme close-up macro stance with shallow depth of field and the foreground stitches sharp. Low skimming side light from camera right modelling the pile without any specular blowout. Cream base tone #F5EDE2 with the surrounding fabric falling softly out of focus. The macro detail occupies 55-60% of the frame and the remaining space is defocused fabric, so there is no extra whitespace. Negative: no blurry subject at the focal point, no plastic-looking synthetic sheen, no pilling damage or lint, no repeated knit pattern, no lettering, no watermark.

shots.intent: 让买家一次比较两个色路，降低选款犹豫并提升加购。
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level two-up pairing, both units at identical scale and cropped on the same line
shots.lighting: identical bright warm key on both units, matched soft contact shadows, no lighting drift
shots.whitespace: even margins between the two units
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant screen of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Two units of the garment paired straight-on at eye level, identical scale, identical pose and identical crop line so the only difference is the surface colourway carried from the reference. Bright warm key light matched across both units with identical soft contact shadows and no lighting drift. Seamless backdrop #FAF7F2. No props. The pair occupies 60-70% of the frame with even margins between the two units. Negative: no mixed lighting or mismatched scale between the units, no invented colour names or swatch lettering, no third colourway, no hue shift away from the supplied reference, no watermark.

shots.intent: 以空白参数行与结构引线消除尺码与做工疑虑，完成信任收口。
shots.camera: high 45-degree overhead angle looking down on the flat spec layout
shots.lighting: even flat high-key lighting, no directional shadow, no hotspot
shots.background: camel matte board #B98A5E carrying cream #F5EDE2 panels
shots.props: one blank thin-line garment drawing, empty ruled table rows, two empty stamp frames
shots.whitespace: clean negative space between the rows and around the drawing
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust and spec screen laid out flat. {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a high 45-degree overhead angle looking down on a structured layout: one blank thin-line drawing of the garment with dotted leader lines, a ruled parameter table of empty cells and two empty stamp frames. Even flat high-key lighting with no directional shadow. Camel matte board #B98A5E carrying cream #F5EDE2 panels. The garment drawing and its layout occupy 35-40% of the frame with clean negative space between the rows. Negative: no readable numbers or measurements, no dense body text, no garbled characters, no certification seals, ratings or badges, no competitor marks, no watermark.

provenance.notes: 源 7 张逐图事实：01 白底对镜自拍半身，手机遮面、链条小方包与串饰；02 浅色无缝棚正身 3/4，宽松落肩与大容量插袋；03 侧身 3/4 双手插袋；04 背侧 45 度展示帽型；05 蹲姿手持外带咖啡杯，搭配厚底运动鞋；06 浅色棚正面全身站姿；07 上半为绒面地上的尺码表（多列多行数值），下半为白底结构线稿加尺寸引线，右侧另有一件浅色同款。品类判定：源平台类目把该产品挂在女装上衣/卫衣一类，但卫衣不是本库 L2 表内字符串，据图判定 L1 女装、L2 上衣（套头无开襟无门襟，故不入外套），leaf 取女式宽松抓绒连帽卫衣；01-06 为同一件主产品的分镜变化而非同构图换色色卡，07 仅作空白规格信息屏素材，故不构成变体画廊。已剥离：原品牌字标与系列名、原平台店铺字样、模特面容与身份（全部改为颈部以下裁切或背影）、尺码表内全部数值与列名、线稿尺寸标注文字、源图英文标题与原句文案、任何评分角标与平台徽章；产品一律以 {product} 占位，色板与背景体系另建为暖白-燕麦灰-奶油绒-驼强调的暖中性棚场系统。
